# The Integrity Man Network

> A global, non-denominational community of men committed to achieving true success by living lives of integrity while working to advance the eternal purpose of God.

## About
The Integrity Man Network (TIMN) gathers men who pursue God, work, and integrity. The site offers articles, courses, events, a store, donations, and a member community.
